description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzAnniversaryDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for data access related to employee anniversaries, including retrieving upcoming anniversaries and counting them.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for retrieving employee anniversary data within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Returns a list of upcoming employee anniversaries based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for employee anniversaries based on filtering criteria.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of upcoming employee anniversaries matching the filter criteria.
